verdict.rationale: Recruitee lists digital offer letters with eSignatures and pre-onboarding/onboarding features. Its webhooks, which send HTTP POST requests when chosen events occur, plus the authenticated API could in principle push new-hire data to downstream systems via custom work. Nothing in the evidence shows native HRIS or payroll integrations that carry a signed offer's data over without re-entry. Missing for 10: documented HRIS/payroll connectors, a signed-offer-to-onboarding handoff flow, field mapping of new-hire data, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
